displayName: Issue Commit: commit messages that explain why
description: Finds the open GitHub/GitLab issue your staged change addresses, then writes a commit message with both What and Why. Works with GitHub Copilot, OpenAI, DeepSeek, Qwen, Ollama and any OpenAI-compatible API.
untrusted: Issue Commit runs git and sends your diff to a model, so it only runs in trusted workspaces.
cmd.configureProject: Configure Issue Search for This Project…
walk.title: Get started with Issue Commit
walk.description: Commit messages that explain why, grounded in the issue your change fixes.
walk.model.title: Pick a model
walk.model.description:
Use GitHub Copilot with no key, or paste a key for OpenAI, DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi, GLM, OpenRouter, or run a local model with Ollama.
[Set up a model](command:issueCommit.setupModel)
walk.issues.title: Connect your issue tracker (optional)
walk.issues.description:
Public GitHub/GitLab repositories work out of the box. Add a token for private repositories, self-hosted GitLab, or a higher GitHub rate limit.
[Add a token](command:issueCommit.setIssueToken)
[Configure sources](command:issueCommit.configureProject)
walk.generate.title: Generate a message
walk.generate.description:
Stage your changes, then click ✨ in the Source Control title bar. The draft appears with the linked issue; nothing is committed for you.
[Generate now](command:issueCommit.generate)
walk.tune.title: Make it yours
walk.tune.description:
Choose the message language and format, add house rules, or switch the ✨ button to quick mode.
[Open settings](command:issueCommit.settings)
config.model.provider: Which model to use. Run **Issue Commit: Set Up Model…** to configure it interactively.
config.model.provider.auto: Use the API below if `model.baseUrl` is set; otherwise a VS Code language model such as GitHub Copilot.
config.model.provider.api: Any OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions API (OpenAI, DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi, GLM, OpenRouter, Ollama, a company gateway…).
config.model.provider.lm: A model provided inside VS Code, such as GitHub Copilot. No API key needed.
config.model.baseUrl: API base URL, the part before `/chat/completions`. Examples: `https://api.openai.com/v1`, `https://api.deepseek.com`, `http://localhost:11434/v1` (Ollama). HTTPS is required except on localhost.
config.model.name: Model name exactly as the provider spells it, e.g. `gpt-4.1-mini`, `deepseek-chat`, `qwen-plus`, `llama3.1`.
config.model.token: API key in plain text. Prefer **Set Up Model…** or **Set / Clear Model API Key…**, which keep the key in Secret Storage. If set, this value wins. Never synced.
config.model.vscodeLm: For `vscode-lm`: model id, `vendor/family` (e.g. `copilot/gpt-4o`) or family. Empty picks the first Copilot model.
config.model.timeoutSeconds: Timeout for a single model request, in seconds.
config.issues.enabled: Search open issues to explain why. Turn off to write messages from the diff only.
config.issues.autoDetect: Find issue trackers from Git remotes on github.com and gitlab.com. Self-hosted instances must be listed in `issues.sources`.
config.issues.sources: Extra issue trackers, merged with the detected ones. Example: `[{ "url": "https://gitlab.example.com/group/project", "provider": "gitlab" }]`. Use a self-hosted GitHub Enterprise URL with `"provider": "github"`.
config.issues.autoSelect: Pre-select the top issue when the model is confident enough. You can always change it before using the message.
config.issues.autoSelect.high: Only strong matches (default). A branch named after the issue also counts.
config.issues.useBranchName: Treat an issue number in the branch name (`fix/123-crash`, `issue-45`) as a candidate. Keys like `PROJ-123` are ignored.
config.issues.topN: How many candidate issues to show.
config.issues.poolSize: How many recently updated open issues to search per tracker.
config.issues.chunkSize: How many issue titles the model scans per request in the first stage. Lower it if the right issue gets missed.
config.issues.maxBodyChars: Characters of each issue body the model reads in the second stage.
config.issues.cacheMinutes: Reuse the issue list for this many minutes when you run again. `0` always refetches. **Search again** always refetches.
config.github.token: GitHub token in plain text, sent only to `api.github.com`. Needed for private repositories; raises the rate limit from 60 to 5,000 requests/hour. Prefer **Set Issue Platform Token…**. Never synced.
config.gitlab.token: GitLab token in plain text, used only for `gitlab.com`. For self-managed GitLab use `issues.tokensByOrigin`. Never synced.
config.issues.tokensByOrigin: Tokens for self-hosted trackers, by exact HTTPS origin, e.g. `{ "https://gitlab.example.com": "glpat-…" }`. A token is never sent to any other origin. Never synced.
config.message.language: Language of the commit message. The type keyword (`fix:` …) stays English.
config.message.language.auto: Follow the VS Code display language.
config.message.format.conventional: Conventional Commits: `type: summary` (feat, fix, perf, style, refactor, docs, test, ci, build, chore).
config.message.format.plain: A plain imperative summary, no type prefix.
config.message.trailer: How the linked issue is referenced at the end of the message. Same repository: `#12`; same host: `owner/repo#12`; elsewhere: the full URL.
config.message.trailer.fixes: `Fixes #12`: closes the issue on merge. You are asked to confirm each time.
config.message.instructions: House rules added to every request, e.g. `Use a scope from: api, ui, docs` or `Mention the ticket in the body`. Rules that conflict with the format are ignored. Put this in workspace settings to share it with your team.
config.message.useHistory: Show the model a few recent commit messages from this repository so drafts match your project's tone and length. Only messages are sent, never code.
config.diff.maxChars: Longer diffs keep the first 70% and the last 30% of this many characters. Lock files, minified bundles and source maps are left out first.
config.workflow.scmButton: What the ✨ button in the Source Control title bar does.
config.workflow.scmButton.panel: Open the review panel: see the candidate issues, edit, revise and score the draft.
config.workflow.scmButton.quick: Pick the issue in a quick list and write the message straight into the commit box.
config.workflow.autoGenerate: Write the first draft as soon as the search finishes, using the pre-selected issue.
config.workflow.closeAfterApply: Close the panel after **Use this message**.
